title: Good Outweighing the Bad
description: Dad ofter "lectured me" which at the time seemed annoying but I did remember them. Life could be thought as worthwhile if the good outweighed the bad. I later used this concept to create a "Health Index" based on SEITWH vectors for AI, where S= Structure that opposed Entropy, I= Information to build with, E= Free Energy as the numerator and the negative vectors of T= Trust Loss, W=Waste (inevitable), and H=Harm as the denominator.
